messages.message: Held two separate roles at Groundswell:
ETL Developer (first 4 months): Developed mappings and workflows in Informatica PowerCenter for data integration and warehousing projects.
Software Engineer (remaining period): Developed a C++ web application using the Wt framework, following a client-server, three-tier architecture.
Built server-side rendered user interfaces and implemented backend logic using Wt Dbo for ORM and database interactions.
Implemented inter-service communication using ZeroC Ice, an object-oriented RPC framework.
Worked in a Linux environment with GCC, Make, and GDB, and managed source control with Git.
Designed and maintained Jenkins CI/CD pipelines to automate nightly builds and deployments.
C++ development for web applications, including backend business logic, database interactions, and server-side rendering using the Wt framework.
Distributed systems architecture and design principles for building reliable applications.
Informatica PowerCenter for data warehousing operations (mapping design and development for ETL processes).
